channel.title: stet changelog
channel.description: What shipped in stet, dated. One entry per feature.

item.title: Keys that say what they are
item.description: Every key names its element; titles and descriptions preview as a search result and a share card.

item.title: Dashboard preview and a safer commit gate
item.description: The preview follows the key you pick, at desktop, tablet and mobile widths; the pre-commit gate uses the stet you installed.

item.title: The dashboard
item.description: stet dev opens a dashboard on your machine: find the words, type, see them on the page, and commit.

item.title: Plain HTML sites
item.description: stet runs on a site that's only HTML files: marked elements, one file for the words, and a check that catches hand edits.

item.title: Page titles, markdown pages and Astro
item.description: seo check fails a page with no title; pages scan reads markdown pages; init detects Astro.

item.title: Environments
item.description: Staging and production as named store connections — never a second schema, never copied data.

item.title: Offline SEO checks
item.description: stet seo check: eight rules over committed copy, no network, no database — runs on a fork PR.

item.title: The web target
item.description: The target adapter seam, with the web target as its first implementation.

item.title: The CLI
item.description: draft, publish, revert, pull and doctor from the terminal; the committed bundle and a stdlib-only Python reader.

item.title: Stores and publishing
item.description: Four store adapters behind one conformance suite; publishing as a single transaction with one-click revert.

item.title: The content core: typed keys, snapshot fallback
item.description: The registry, the committed snapshot, and the read path — every string a typed key with a fallback in your repo.
